B0GV4CWB6D.title: Heiman Smoke Detector, Matter Over Thread, with Temp&Humidity Sensor, S1-TM
bullets: 【Matter & Thread Smart Smoke Detector】Compatible with AppleHome, GoogleHome, Alexa, SmartThings, Homey, and Home Assistant Through THREAD BORDER ROUTER. No Wi-Fi needed for local smart home automations.(NOTE：Connect HA: Enable IPv6 on the HA box, and make sure the LAN isn’t blocking IPv6/RA/mDNS. You don’t need internet IPv6.)

【Dual-Beam Photoelectric Smoke Alarm】This photoelectric smoke alarm accurately detects smoldering fires and fine smoke. Reduces false alarms from cooking and steam compared to ionization detectors, providing greater peace of mind.

【UL217 10th Ed. Certified】This fire alarm meets strict UL and FCC standards (CSFM listed). Features UL94 V-0 flame-retardant housing and won the German Red Dot Design Award. Built under strict quality control, it combines reliable safety with elegant aesthetics for modern homes.

【Smoke alarm with Climate Monitoring】More than just a smoke alarm—built-in sensors track real-time temperature and humidity. Monitor your indoor climate remotely via the app for added safety and everyday comfort.

【Battery Powered & Easy Install】Powered by a battery (included) . Simple Magnetic&screw mounting. Features an 85 dB alarm, LED indicators, and one-touch test/silence, keeping you informed of the alarm’s status.

【NOTES】This Matter & Thread-enabled smoke detector must work with a compatible Matter hub with Thread Border Router for smart connection. Supported hubs include Google TV Streamer, Nest Hub (2nd gen), Nest Hub Max, HomePod (2nd Gen), HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K (2021/2022), Aeotec Smart Home Hub, SmartThings Hub v3, SmartThings Station, Echo (4th Gen), Echo Show 8 (3rd Gen) and Echo Show 10 (3rd Gen).【You can check main picture to learn more】

B0FVSVNJBY.title: Heiman Smart Smoke Detector, Matter Over Thread Fire Alarm,Real-Time Alerts
bullets: Matter & Thread Smart Smoke Detector: Compatible with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant via a THREAD BORDER ROUTER. No Wi-Fi needed for local smart home automations.（Connect HA : Enable IPv6 on the HA box, and make sure the LAN isn’t blocking IPv6/RA/mDNS. You don’t need internet IPv6.)

Dual-Beam Photoelectric Sensor:​ This photoelectric smoke alarm accurately detects smoldering fires and fine smoke. Reduces false alarms from cooking and steam compared to ionization detectors, providing greater peace of mind.

UL217 10th Ed. Certified:​ This fire alarm meets strict UL and FCC standards (CSFM listed). Features UL94 V-0 flame-retardant housing and won the German Red Dot Design Award. Built under strict quality control, it combines reliable safety with elegant aesthetics for modern homes.

Battery Powered & Easy Install:​ Powered by a CR123A battery (included) for power outage protection. Simple screw mounting. Features an 85 dB alarm, LED indicators, and one-touch test/silence, keeping you informed of the alarm’s status.
Local Security Automation:​ Use as a smart smoke sensor to trigger offline routines (cut power, turn on lights). Doubles as a deterrent siren for home security when linked with door/window sensors.

Requirement Notice: This Matter & Thread-enabled smoke detector must work with a compatible Matter hub with Thread Border Router for smart connection. Supported hubs include Google TV Streamer, Nest Hub (2nd gen), Nest Hub Max, HomePod (2nd Gen), HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K (2021/2022), Aeotec Smart Home Hub, SmartThings Hub v3, SmartThings Station, Echo (4th Gen), Echo Show 8 (3rd Gen) and Echo Show 10 (3rd Gen).

B0G135MZJY.title: Heiman Smart Carbon Monoxide Detectors, Matter Over Thread CO Alarm, C1-M
bullets: Matter Over Thread Native Integration: Works with Apple Home/Google Home/Amazon Alexa/SmartThings/Home Assistant. Thread Border Router (e.g., SmartThings Hub v3, Home Assistant SkyConnect) is required.（Connect HA : Need enable IPv6 on the HA box, and make sure the LAN isn’t blocking IPv6/RA/mDNS. You don’t need internet IPv6.)

UL 2034 5th Edition Certified Safety:​ Built around a Japan-made Figaro TGS5141 electrochemical sensor and tested to UL 2034 5th Edition to eliminate invisible threats, dependable residential CO safety. This CO detector is the Winner of the Red Dot Design Award, delivering reliable performance in a sleek, modern form.

Long Life Battery with Low-Power Design:​ Powered by a single CR123A lithium battery rated up to 10 years of continuous monitoring with low-battery chirp and end-of-life signal; wire-free wall or ceiling mount keeps protection active during power outages where CO leaks are most dangerous

Compact & Durable Housing:​ 2.75'' diameter and 1.45'' height housing fits tight spaces near furnaces, water heaters, fireplaces, and garage adjacencies; While UL94 V-0 flame-retardant ABS+PC housing adds heat resistance and long-term durability, perfect for home.

Tool-Free Installation:​ Screw or magnetic adhesive mount options support damage-free setup in apartments and rentals; one-touch Test/Silence button supports quick checks and temporary nuisance alarm hush

CO-Only Dedicated Detection:​ Focuses exclusively on colorless, odorless carbon monoxide instead of mixing sensors so response stays fast and false alarms stay low; you can install Matter smoke alarm(S1-M/S1-TM), CO detector(C1-M), and link both through Matter for coordinated whole-home emergency responses

Requirement Notice: This Matter & Thread-enabled CO detector must work with a compatible Matter hub with Thread Border Router for smart connection. Supported hubs include Google TV Streamer, Nest Hub (2nd gen), Nest Hub Max, HomePod (2nd Gen), HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K (2021/2022), Aeotec Smart Home Hub, SmartThings Hub v3, SmartThings Station, Echo (4th Gen), Echo Show 8 (3rd Gen) and Echo Show 10 (3rd Gen).(You can check product details to learn more)
